title: The Bluff
synopsis: You're a retired pirate captain living quietly in the Caribbean. The British Navy has docked. So has your old daughter. So has your old life.

nodes.text: The cove is quiet. You sit on a porch with a leg up. The harbor, on the horizon, has more sails than it had yesterday.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Watch them.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cautious—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: She walks up your beach in trousers and a cutlass. She is taller. She is also, you can tell, angry.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Captain Hayes of the British Navy has, with his crew, taken your old port. He has a writ in his pocket and a small smile.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Read the writ” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Pride.

nodes.text: The town bar is owned by an old shipmate of yours, Maria. She is, in this scene, the only honest person you know.

choices.consequence: “Tell Maria everything” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Trust.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Save half.

nodes.text: Your daughter, drunk, finally tells you why she came. The reason is a ship, a mission, and a name from your past.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Patient.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Five of your old crew are alive. Two are in Havana. Two are in Tortuga. One is, embarrassingly, also retired three coves down.

choices.consequence: “Call them” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Reunion.
You commit to “Plan without them.” The story records the instinct as “Solo” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Hayes offers you a deal. The deal is, by the standards of the navy, generous. The deal is, by the standards of your daughter, an insult.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Take the deal.” The story records the instinct as “Pragmatic” and carries it forward.
“Refuse” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.

nodes.text: Maria has, in her back-room, a schooner you didn't know she had. She has, you realize, been retired in the loud sense — actively.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Use the schooner.” The story records the instinct as “Asset” and carries it forward.
Don't drag her in.

nodes.text: Your daughter's mission, finally explained: a stolen something, a hostage, a ledger that, if released, would end Hayes' career.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Family.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Practical—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You sail. The first hours feel old. By the second day you are, weirdly, twenty again, in a body that is fifty.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Memory.
You commit to “Pace yourself.” The story records the instinct as “Wisdom” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Hayes, on a larger ship, follows. He is faster on open water. You know smaller channels.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take the channels” back. Local shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Confidence.

nodes.text: A storm finds you. The schooner, by Maria's calm, survives. So do you.

choices.consequence: “Push through” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
“Wait it out” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: Your old crew in Tortuga joins. They are older, slower, more dangerous. The reunion is, briefly, the best night of your decade.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Tell them the plan” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Let them think it's bigger.” The story records the instinct as “Recruit” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The ledger is hidden, by your daughter's intelligence, in a chapel. The chapel is also, you realize, where you were married.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Memory.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.

nodes.text: Hayes finds you mid-sea. The two ships, briefly, are within hailing distance.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Hail him.” The story records the instinct as “Words” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Action—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The hostage, recovered, turns out to be the wife of a man you once wronged. She forgives you immediately. You realize forgiveness travels strangely.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Apologize.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Quiet—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Hayes' ship runs aground in your channels. He is alive. He is also, in this corner of the world, not safe.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mercy.
There is no taking “Take him prisoner” back. Pragmatic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The town watches from the dock as you sail back in. The crowd is, somehow, applauding.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Bow.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Maria pours rum. The crew, your daughter, and you sit at the long table. You realize you have a family you did not, last week, know you had.

choices.consequence: “Stay” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Family.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: A formal letter from the Navy. It is, against expectation, a pardon. You realize Hayes wrote it himself.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
There is no taking “Frame it but stay private” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She tells you, on the porch, that she will visit again. You tell her you will let her go without making a scene about it. You make a small scene anyway.

choices.consequence: “Make the scene short” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You stay in your cove. The bar keeps you in rum. Maria keeps you in stories. Your daughter visits twice a year. The waves do, in fact, ignore you mostly. You like that.
You sail occasionally — small jobs, smaller crews — and become, in time, a kind of grandfather to a new generation of sailors. The Navy, by treaty and convenience, leaves you alone.
You marry, late, a woman you should have married decades earlier. Maria officiates because nobody else is left. The chapel — same one — laughs at you, kindly, when the kiss takes too long.
